text.KJV: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
text.ASV: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
text.WEB: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

text.KJV: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
text.ASV: Even as it is written in Isaiah the prophet, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way.
text.WEB: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

text.KJV: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
text.ASV: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight;
text.WEB: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

text.KJV: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
text.ASV: John came, who baptized in the wilderness and preached the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins.
text.WEB: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

text.KJV: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
text.ASV: And there went out unto him all the country of Judaea, and all they of Jerusalem; And they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
text.WEB: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

text.KJV: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
text.ASV: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and `had' a leathern girdle about his loins, and did eat locusts and wild honey.
text.WEB: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

text.KJV: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
text.ASV: And he preached, saying, There cometh after me he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
text.WEB: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

text.KJV: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
text.ASV: I baptized you in water; But he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
text.WEB: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
text.ASV: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in the Jordan.
text.WEB: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

text.KJV: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
text.ASV: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens rent asunder, and the Spirit as a dove descending upon him:
text.WEB: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

text.KJV: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
text.ASV: And a voice came out of the heavens, Thou art my beloved Son, in thee I am well pleased.
text.WEB: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

text.KJV: And immediately the spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
text.ASV: And straightway the Spirit driveth him forth into the wilderness.
text.WEB: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

text.KJV: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
text.ASV: And he was in the wilderness forty days tempted of Satan; And he was with the wild beasts; And the angels ministered unto him.
text.WEB: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

text.KJV: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
text.ASV: Now after John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,
text.WEB: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

text.KJV: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
text.ASV: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe in the gospel.
text.WEB: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

text.KJV: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
text.ASV: And passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net in the sea; for they were fishers.
text.WEB: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

text.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

text.KJV: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
text.ASV: And straightway they left the nets, and followed him.
text.WEB: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

text.KJV: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
text.ASV: And going on a little further, he saw James the `son' of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending the nets.
text.WEB: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

text.KJV: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
text.ASV: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
text.WEB: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

text.KJV: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
text.ASV: And they go into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
text.WEB: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

text.KJV: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
text.ASV: And they were astonished at his teaching: For he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
text.WEB: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

text.KJV: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
text.ASV: And straightway there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
text.WEB: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

text.KJV: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
text.ASV: saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
text.WEB: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”

text.KJV: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
text.ASV: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
text.WEB: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

text.KJV: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
text.ASV: And the unclean spirit, tearing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
text.WEB: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

text.KJV: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
text.ASV: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.
text.WEB: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

text.KJV: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
text.ASV: And the report of him went out straightway everywhere into all the region of Galilee round about.
text.WEB: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

text.KJV: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
text.ASV: And straightway, when they were come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
text.WEB: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

text.KJV: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
text.ASV: Now Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever; and straightway they tell him of her:
text.WEB: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

text.KJV: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
text.ASV: and he came and took her by the hand, and raised her up; and the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
text.WEB: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.

text.KJV: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
text.ASV: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were sick, and them that were possessed with demons.
text.WEB: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.

text.KJV: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
text.ASV: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
text.WEB: All the city was gathered together at the door.

text.KJV: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
text.ASV: And he healed many that were sick with divers diseases, and cast out many demons; and he suffered not the demons to speak, because they knew him.
text.WEB: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

text.KJV: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
text.ASV: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose up and went out, and departed into a desert place, and there prayed.
text.WEB: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

text.KJV: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
text.ASV: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him;
text.WEB: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;

text.KJV: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
text.ASV: and they found him, and say unto him, All are seeking thee.
text.WEB: and they found him, and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Let us go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also; for to this end came I forth.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

text.KJV: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
text.ASV: And he went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
text.WEB: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

text.KJV: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
text.ASV: And there cometh to him a leper, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
text.WEB: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

text.KJV: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
text.ASV: And being moved with compassion, he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou made clean.
text.WEB: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

text.KJV: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
text.ASV: And straightway the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
text.WEB: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.

text.KJV: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
text.ASV: And he strictly charged him, and straightway sent him out,
text.WEB: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,

text.KJV: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
text.ASV: and saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
text.WEB: and said to him, “See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

text.KJV: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
text.ASV: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to spread abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
text.WEB: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.

text.KJV: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
text.ASV: And when he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was noised that he was in the house.
text.WEB: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.

text.KJV: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
text.ASV: And many were gathered together, so that there was no longer room `for them', no, not even about the door: and he spake the word unto them.
text.WEB: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

text.KJV: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
text.ASV: And they come, bringing unto him a man sick of the palsy, borne of four.
text.WEB: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

text.KJV: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
text.ASV: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the crowd, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed whereon the sick of the palsy lay.
text.WEB: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

text.KJV: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
text.ASV: And Jesus seeing their faith saith unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins are forgiven.
text.WEB: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

text.KJV: But there was certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
text.ASV: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
text.WEB: But there were some of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

text.KJV: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
text.ASV: Why doth this man thus speak? he blasphemeth: who can forgive sins but one, `even' God?
text.WEB: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

text.KJV: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
text.ASV: And straightway Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, saith unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
text.WEB: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

text.KJV: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
text.ASV: Which is easier, to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins are forgiven; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
text.WEB: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?’

text.KJV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
text.ASV: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins (he saith to the sick of the palsy),
text.WEB: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

text.KJV: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
text.ASV: I say unto thee, Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thy house.
text.WEB: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

text.KJV: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
text.ASV: And he arose, and straightway took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
text.WEB: He arose, and immediately took up the mat, and went out in front of them all; so that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

text.KJV: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
text.ASV: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
text.WEB: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

text.KJV: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
text.ASV: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the `son' of Alphaeus sitting at the place of toll, and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
text.WEB: As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, that he was sitting at meat in his house, and many publicans and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
text.WEB: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

text.KJV: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
text.ASV: And the scribes of the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and publicans, said unto his disciples, `How is it' that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
text.WEB: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

text.KJV: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
text.ASV: And when Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of a physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
text.WEB: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

text.KJV: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
text.ASV: And John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting: and they come and say unto him, Why do John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
text.WEB: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

text.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Can the sons of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

text.KJV: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
text.ASV: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.
text.WEB: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.

text.KJV: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
text.ASV: No man seweth a piece of undressed cloth on an old garment: else that which should fill it up taketh from it, the new from the old, and a worse rent is made.
text.WEB: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

text.KJV: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
text.ASV: And no man putteth new wine into old wineskins; else the wine will burst the skins, and the wine perisheth, and the skins: but `they put' new wine into fresh wine-skins.
text.WEB: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, that he was going on the sabbath day through the grainfields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears.
text.WEB: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields, and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

text.KJV: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
text.ASV: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
text.WEB: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Did ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry, he, and they that were with him?
text.WEB: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

text.KJV: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
text.ASV: How he entered into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the showbread, which it is not lawful to eat save for the priests, and gave also to them that were with him?
text.WEB: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
text.ASV: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
text.WEB: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

text.KJV: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
text.ASV: so that the Son of man is lord even of the sabbath.
text.WEB: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

text.KJV: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
text.ASV: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there who had his hand withered.
text.WEB: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there who had his hand withered.

text.KJV: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
text.ASV: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
text.WEB: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

text.KJV: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
text.ASV: And he saith unto the man that had his hand withered, Stand forth.
text.WEB: He said to the man who had his hand withered, “Stand up.”

text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful on the sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? to save a life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?” But they were silent.

text.KJV: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
text.ASV: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their heart, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched it forth; and his hand was restored.
text.WEB: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

text.KJV: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
text.ASV: And the Pharisees went out, and straightway with the Herodians took counsel against him, how they might destroy him.
text.WEB: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

text.KJV: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
text.ASV: And Jesus with his disciples withdrew to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed; and from Judaea,
text.WEB: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples, and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

text.KJV: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
text.ASV: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and beyond the Jordan, and about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came unto him.
text.WEB: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

text.KJV: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
text.ASV: And he spake to his disciples, that a little boat should wait on him because of the crowd, lest they should throng him:
text.WEB: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

text.KJV: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
text.ASV: for he had healed many; insomuch that as many as had plagues pressed upon him that they might touch him.
text.WEB: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

text.KJV: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
text.ASV: And the unclean spirits, whensoever they beheld him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
text.WEB: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

text.KJV: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
text.ASV: And he charged them much that they should not make him known.
text.WEB: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

text.KJV: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
text.ASV: And he goeth up into the mountain, and calleth unto him whom he himself would; and they went unto him.
text.WEB: He went up into the mountain, and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

text.KJV: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
text.ASV: And he appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
text.WEB: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach,

text.KJV: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
text.ASV: and to have authority to cast out demons:
text.WEB: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

text.KJV: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
text.ASV: and Simon he surnamed Peter;
text.WEB: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

text.KJV: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
text.ASV: and James the `son' of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and them he surnamed Boanerges, which is, Sons of thunder:
text.WEB: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

text.KJV: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
text.ASV: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the `son' of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Cananaean,
text.WEB: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

text.KJV: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
text.ASV: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. And he cometh into a house.
text.WEB: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

text.KJV: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
text.ASV: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
text.WEB: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

text.KJV: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
text.ASV: And when his friends heard it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
text.WEB: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him: for they said, “He is insane.”

text.KJV: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
text.ASV: And the scribes that came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and, By the prince of the demons casteth he out the demons.
text.WEB: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

text.KJV: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
text.ASV: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
text.WEB: He summoned them, and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

text.KJV: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
text.ASV: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
text.WEB: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

text.KJV: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
text.ASV: And if a house be divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
text.WEB: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

text.KJV: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
text.ASV: And if Satan hath rise up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
text.WEB: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

text.KJV: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
text.ASV: But no one can enter into the house of the strong `man', and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong `man'; and then he will spoil his house.
text.WEB: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder, unless he first binds the strong man; and then he will plunder his house.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, All their sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and their blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

text.KJV: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation.
text.ASV: but whosoever shall blaspheme against the Holy Spirit hath never forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin:
text.WEB: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

text.KJV: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
text.ASV: because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
text.WEB: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

text.KJV: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
text.ASV: And there come his mother and his brethren; and, standing without, they sent unto him, calling him.
text.WEB: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

text.KJV: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
text.ASV: And a multitude was sitting about him; and they say unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
text.WEB: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

text.KJV: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
text.ASV: And he answereth them, and saith, Who is my mother and my brethren?
text.WEB: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

text.KJV: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
text.ASV: And looking round on them that sat round about him, he saith, Behold, my mother and my brethren!
text.WEB: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

text.KJV: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
text.ASV: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
text.WEB: For whoever does the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.”

text.KJV: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
text.ASV: And again he began to teach by the sea side. And there is gathered unto him a very great multitude, so that he entered into a boat, and sat in the sea; and all the multitude were by the sea on the land.
text.WEB: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea, and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

text.KJV: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
text.ASV: And he taught them many things in parables, and said unto them in his teaching,
text.WEB: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

text.KJV: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
text.ASV: Hearken: Behold, the sower went forth to sow:
text.WEB: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow,

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
text.ASV: and it came to pass, as he sowed, some `seed' fell by the way side, and the birds came and devoured it.
text.WEB: and as he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

text.KJV: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
text.ASV: And other fell on the rocky `ground', where it had not much earth; and straightway it sprang up, because it had no deepness of earth:
text.WEB: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

text.KJV: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
text.ASV: and when the sun was risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
text.WEB: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

text.KJV: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
text.ASV: And other fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
text.WEB: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

text.KJV: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
text.ASV: And others fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing; and brought forth, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.
text.WEB: Others fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
text.ASV: And he said, Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
text.WEB: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

text.KJV: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
text.ASV: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parables.
text.WEB: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Unto you is given the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all things are done in parables:
text.WEB: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

text.KJV: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
text.ASV: that seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest haply they should turn again, and it should be forgiven them.
text.WEB: that ‘seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how shall ye know all the parables?
text.WEB: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

text.KJV: The sower soweth the word.
text.ASV: The sower soweth the word.
text.WEB: The farmer sows the word.

text.KJV: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
text.ASV: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; and when they have heard, straightway cometh Satan, and taketh away the word which hath been sown in them.
text.WEB: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes, and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

text.KJV: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
text.ASV: And these in like manner are they that are sown upon the rocky `places', who, when they have heard the word, straightway receive it with joy;
text.WEB: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

text.KJV: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.
text.ASV: and they have no root in themselves, but endure for a while; then, when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, straightway they stumble.
text.WEB: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

text.KJV: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
text.ASV: And others are they that are sown among the thorns; these are they that have heard the word,
text.WEB: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

text.KJV: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
text.ASV: and the cares of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
text.WEB: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

text.KJV: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
text.ASV: And those are they that were sown upon the good ground; such as hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.
text.WEB: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Is the lamp brought to be put under the bushel, or under the bed, `and' not to be put on the stand?
text.WEB: He said to them, “Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

text.KJV: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
text.ASV: For there is nothing hid, save that it should be manifested; neither was `anything' made secret, but that it should come to light.
text.WEB: For there is nothing hidden, except that it should be made known; neither was anything made secret, but that it should come to light.

text.KJV: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
text.ASV: If any man hath ears to hear, let him hear.
text.WEB: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete it shall be measured unto you; and more shall be given unto you.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and more will be given to you who hear.

text.KJV: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
text.ASV: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.
text.WEB: For whoever has, to him will more be given, and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

text.KJV: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
text.ASV: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed upon the earth;
text.WEB: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

text.KJV: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
text.ASV: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, he knoweth not how.
text.WEB: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

text.KJV: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
text.ASV: The earth beareth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
text.WEB: For the earth bears fruit: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

text.KJV: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
text.ASV: But when the fruit is ripe, straightway he putteth forth the sickle, because the harvest is come.
text.WEB: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

text.KJV: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
text.ASV: And he said, How shall we liken the kingdom of God? or in what parable shall we set it forth?
text.WEB: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

text.KJV: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
text.ASV: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown upon the earth, though it be less than all the seeds that are upon the earth,
text.WEB: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

text.KJV: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
text.ASV: yet when it is sown, groweth up, and becometh greater than all the herbs, and putteth out great branches; so that the birds of the heaven can lodge under the shadow thereof.
text.WEB: yet when it is sown, grows up, and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

text.KJV: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
text.ASV: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it;
text.WEB: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

text.KJV: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
text.ASV: and without a parable spake he not unto them: but privately to his own disciples he expounded all things.
text.WEB: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

text.KJV: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
text.ASV: And on that day, when even was come, he saith unto them, Let us go over unto the other side.
text.WEB: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

text.KJV: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
text.ASV: And leaving the multitude, they take him with them, even as he was, in the boat. And other boats were with him.
text.WEB: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

text.KJV: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
text.ASV: And there ariseth a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the boat, insomuch that the boat was now filling.
text.WEB: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

text.KJV: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
text.ASV: And he himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion: and they awake him, and say unto him, Teacher, carest thou not that we perish?
text.WEB: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion, and they woke him up, and told him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

text.KJV: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
text.ASV: And he awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
text.WEB: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Why are ye fearful? have ye not yet faith?
text.WEB: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

text.KJV: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
text.ASV: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
text.WEB: They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

text.KJV: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
text.ASV: And they came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gerasenes.
text.WEB: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

text.KJV: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
text.ASV: And when he was come out of the boat, straightway there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
text.WEB: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

text.KJV: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
text.ASV: who had his dwelling in the tombs: and no man could any more bind him, no, not with a chain;
text.WEB: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

text.KJV: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
text.ASV: because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been rent asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: and no man had strength to tame him.
text.WEB: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

text.KJV: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
text.ASV: And always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
text.WEB: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

text.KJV: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
text.ASV: And when he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and worshipped him;
text.WEB: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

text.KJV: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
text.ASV: and crying out with a loud voice, he saith, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the Most High God? I adjure thee by God, torment me not.
text.WEB: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

text.KJV: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
text.ASV: For he said unto him, Come forth, thou unclean spirit, out of the man.
text.WEB: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

text.KJV: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
text.ASV: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he saith unto him, My name is Legion; for we are many.
text.WEB: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

text.KJV: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
text.ASV: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
text.WEB: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

text.KJV: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
text.ASV: Now there was there on the mountain side a great herd of swine feeding.
text.WEB: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

text.KJV: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
text.ASV: And they besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
text.WEB: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

text.KJV: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
text.ASV: And he gave them leave. And the unclean spirits came out, and entered into the swine: and the herd rushed down the steep into the sea, `in number' about two thousand; and they were drowned in the sea.
text.WEB: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

text.KJV: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
text.ASV: And they that fed them fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they came to see what it was that had come to pass.
text.WEB: Those who fed them fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

text.KJV: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
text.ASV: And they come to Jesus, and behold him that was possessed with demons sitting, clothed and in his right mind, `even' him that had the legion: and they were afraid.
text.WEB: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

text.KJV: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
text.ASV: And they that saw it declared unto them how it befell him that was possessed with demons, and concerning the swine.
text.WEB: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

text.KJV: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
text.ASV: And they began to beseech him to depart from their borders.
text.WEB: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

text.KJV: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
text.ASV: And as he was entering into the boat, he that had been possessed with demons besought him that he might be with him.
text.WEB: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

text.KJV: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
text.ASV: And he suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go to thy house unto thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and `how' he had mercy on thee.
text.WEB: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.”

text.KJV: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
text.ASV: And he went his way, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men marvelled.
text.WEB: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

text.KJV: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
text.ASV: And when Jesus had crossed over again in the boat unto the other side, a great multitude was gathered unto him; and he was by the sea.
text.WEB: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

text.KJV: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
text.ASV: And there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and seeing him, he falleth at his feet,
text.WEB: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet,

text.KJV: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
text.ASV: and beseecheth him much, saying, My little daughter is at the point of death: `I pray thee', that thou come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be made whole, and live.
text.WEB: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

text.KJV: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
text.ASV: And he went with him; and a great multitude followed him, and they thronged him.
text.WEB: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

text.KJV: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
text.ASV: And a woman, who had an issue of blood twelve years,
text.WEB: A certain woman, who had an issue of blood for twelve years,

text.KJV: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
text.ASV: and had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
text.WEB: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

text.KJV: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
text.ASV: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came in the crowd behind, and touched his garment.
text.WEB: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd, and touched his clothes.

text.KJV: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
text.ASV: For she said, If I touch but his garments, I shall be made whole.
text.WEB: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

text.KJV: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
text.ASV: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her plague.
text.WEB: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

text.KJV: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
text.ASV: And straightway Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power `proceeding' from him had gone forth, turned him about in the crowd, and said, Who touched my garments?
text.WEB: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd, and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

text.KJV: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
text.ASV: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
text.WEB: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

text.KJV: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
text.ASV: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
text.WEB: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

text.KJV: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
text.ASV: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
text.WEB: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

text.KJV: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
text.ASV: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
text.WEB: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

text.KJV: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
text.ASV: While he yet spake, they come from the ruler of the synagogue's `house' saying, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Teacher any further?
text.WEB: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

text.KJV: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
text.ASV: But Jesus, not heeding the word spoken, saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Fear not, only believe.
text.WEB: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

text.KJV: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
text.ASV: And he suffered no man to follow with him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
text.WEB: He allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

text.KJV: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
text.ASV: And they come to the house of the ruler of the synagogue; and he beholdeth a tumult, and `many' weeping and wailing greatly.
text.WEB: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

text.KJV: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
text.ASV: And when he was entered in, he saith unto them, Why make ye a tumult, and weep? the child is not dead, but sleepeth.
text.WEB: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

text.KJV: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
text.ASV: And they laughed him to scorn. But he, having put them all forth, taketh the father of the child and her mother and them that were with him, and goeth in where the child was.
text.WEB: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

text.KJV: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
text.ASV: And taking the child by the hand, he saith unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, Arise.
text.WEB: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

text.KJV: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
text.ASV: And straightway the damsel rose up, and walked; for she was twelve years old. And they were amazed straightway with a great amazement.
text.WEB: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

text.KJV: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
text.ASV: And he charged them much that no man should know this: and he commanded that `something' should be given her to eat.
text.WEB: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

text.KJV: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
text.ASV: And he went out from thence; and he cometh into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
text.WEB: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

text.KJV: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
text.ASV: And when the sabbath was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, Whence hath this man these things? and, What is the wisdom that is given unto this man, and `what mean' such mighty works wrought by his hands?
text.WEB: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

text.KJV: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
text.ASV: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, and Joses, and Judas, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended in him.
text.WEB: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” They were offended at him.

text.KJV: But Jesus, said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

text.KJV: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
text.ASV: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
text.WEB: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.

text.KJV: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
text.ASV: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages teaching.
text.WEB: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

text.KJV: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
text.ASV: And he calleth unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;
text.WEB: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

text.KJV: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
text.ASV: and he charged them that they should take nothing for `their' journey, save a staff only; no bread, no wallet, now money in their purse;
text.WEB: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

text.KJV: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
text.ASV: but `to go' shod with sandals: and, `said he', put not on two coats.
text.WEB: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Wheresoever ye enter into a house, there abide till ye depart thence.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

text.KJV: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
text.ASV: And whatsoever place shall not receive you, and they hear you not, as ye go forth thence, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony unto them.
text.WEB: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

text.KJV: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
text.ASV: And they went out, and preached that `men' should repent.
text.WEB: They went out and preached that people should repent.

text.KJV: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
text.ASV: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
text.WEB: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.

text.KJV: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
text.ASV: And king Herod heard `thereof'; for his name had become known: and he said, John the Baptizer is risen from the dead, and therefore do these powers work in him.
text.WEB: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

text.KJV: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
text.ASV: But others said, It is Elijah. And others said, `It is' a prophet, `even' as one of the prophets.
text.WEB: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

text.KJV: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
text.ASV: But Herod, when he heard `thereof', said, John, whom I beheaded, he is risen.
text.WEB: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

text.KJV: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
text.ASV: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife; for he had married her.
text.WEB: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

text.KJV: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
text.ASV: For John said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
text.WEB: For John said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

text.KJV: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
text.ASV: And Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him; and she could not;
text.WEB: Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

text.KJV: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
text.ASV: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. And when he heard him, he was much perplexed; and he heard him gladly.
text.WEB: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

text.KJV: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
text.ASV: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, and the high captains, and the chief men of Galilee;
text.WEB: Then a convenient day came, that Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

text.KJV: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
text.ASV: and when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and them that sat at meat with him; and the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
text.WEB: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

text.KJV: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
text.ASV: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
text.WEB: He swore to her, “Whatever you shall ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

text.KJV: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
text.ASV: And she went out, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptizer.
text.WEB: She went out, and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
