text.KJV: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
text.ASV: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou forthwith give me on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
text.WEB: She came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

text.KJV: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
text.ASV: And the king was exceeding sorry; but for the sake of his oaths, and of them that sat at meat, he would not reject her.
text.WEB: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

text.KJV: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
text.ASV: And straightway the king sent forth a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring his head: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
text.WEB: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring John’s head, and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

text.KJV: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
text.ASV: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the damsel; and the damsel gave it to her mother.
text.WEB: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

text.KJV: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
text.ASV: And when his disciples heard `thereof', they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
text.WEB: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

text.KJV: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
text.ASV: And the apostles gather themselves together unto Jesus; and they told him all things, whatsoever they had done, and whatsoever they had taught.
text.WEB: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while. For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
text.WEB: He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

text.KJV: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
text.ASV: And they went away in the boat to a desert place apart.
text.WEB: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

text.KJV: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
text.ASV: And `the people' saw them going, and many knew `them', and they ran together there on foot from all the cities, and outwent them.
text.WEB: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

text.KJV: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
text.ASV: And he came forth and saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
text.WEB: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.

text.KJV: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
text.ASV: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, The place is desert, and the day is now far spent;
text.WEB: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

text.KJV: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
text.ASV: send them away, that they may go into the country and villages round about, and buy themselves somewhat to eat.
text.WEB: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages, and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

text.KJV: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
text.ASV: But he answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred shillings' worth of bread, and give them to eat?
text.WEB: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give them something to eat?”

text.KJV: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go `and' see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
text.WEB: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

text.KJV: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
text.ASV: And he commanded them that all should sit down by companies upon the green grass.
text.WEB: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

text.KJV: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
text.ASV: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
text.WEB: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

text.KJV: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
text.ASV: And he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake the loaves; and he gave to the disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
text.WEB: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

text.KJV: And they did all eat, and were filled.
text.ASV: And they all ate, and were filled.
text.WEB: They all ate, and were filled.

text.KJV: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
text.ASV: And they took up broken pieces, twelve basketfuls, and also of the fishes.
text.WEB: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

text.KJV: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
text.ASV: And they that ate the loaves were five thousand men.
text.WEB: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

text.KJV: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
text.ASV: And straightway he constrained his disciples to enter into the boat, and to go before `him' unto the other side to Bethsaida, while he himself sendeth the multitude away.
text.WEB: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

text.KJV: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
text.ASV: And after he had taken leave of them, he departed into the mountain to pray.
text.WEB: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

text.KJV: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
text.ASV: And when even was come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
text.WEB: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

text.KJV: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
text.ASV: And seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary unto them, about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them:
text.WEB: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea, and he would have passed by them,

text.KJV: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
text.ASV: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
text.WEB: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

text.KJV: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
text.ASV: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he straightway spake with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
text.WEB: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them, and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

text.KJV: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
text.ASV: And he went up unto them into the boat; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves;
text.WEB: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

text.KJV: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
text.ASV: for they understood not concerning the loaves, but their heart was hardened.
text.WEB: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

text.KJV: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
text.ASV: And when they had crossed over, they came to the land unto Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
text.WEB: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.

text.KJV: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
text.ASV: And when they were come out of the boat, straightway `the people' knew him,
text.WEB: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

text.KJV: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
text.ASV: and ran round about that whole region, and began to carry about on their beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
text.WEB: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.

text.KJV: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
text.ASV: And wheresoever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
text.WEB: Wherever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

text.KJV: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
text.ASV: And there are gathered together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, who had come from Jerusalem,
text.WEB: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

text.KJV: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
text.ASV: and had seen that some of his disciples ate their bread with defiled, that is, unwashen, hands.
text.WEB: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

text.KJV: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
text.ASV: (For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands diligently, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders;
text.WEB: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews, don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

text.KJV: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
text.ASV: and `when they come' from the market-place, except they bathe themselves, they eat not; and many other things there are, which they have received to hold, washings of cups, and pots, and brasen vessels.)
text.WEB: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

text.KJV: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
text.ASV: And the Pharisees and the scribes ask him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with defiled hands?
text.WEB: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

text.KJV: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoreth me with their lips, But their heart is far from me.
text.WEB: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

text.KJV: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
text.ASV: But in vain do they worship me, Teaching `as their' doctrines the precepts of men.
text.WEB: But they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

text.KJV: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
text.ASV: Ye leave the commandment of God, and hold fast the tradition of men.
text.WEB: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Full well do ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your tradition.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

text.KJV: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
text.ASV: For Moses said, Honor thy father and thy mother; and, He that speaketh evil of father or mother, let him die the death:
text.WEB: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’; and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’;

text.KJV: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
text.ASV: but ye say, If a man shall say to his father or his mother, That wherewith thou mightest have been profited by me is Corban, that is to say, Given `to God';
text.WEB: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban, that is to say, given to God”;’

text.KJV: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
text.ASV: ye no longer suffer him to do aught for his father or his mother;
text.WEB: then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

text.KJV: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
text.ASV: making void the word of God by your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things ye do.
text.WEB: making void the word of God by your tradition, which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

text.KJV: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
text.ASV: And he called to him the multitude again, and said unto them, Hear me all of you, and understand:
text.WEB: He called all the multitude to himself, and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

text.KJV: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
text.ASV: there is nothing from without the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
text.WEB: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

text.KJV: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
text.ASV: `If any man hath ears to hear, let him hear.'
text.WEB: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

text.KJV: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
text.ASV: And when he was entered into the house from the multitude, his disciples asked of him the parable.
text.WEB: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Perceive ye not, that whatsoever from without goeth into the man, `it' cannot defile him;
text.WEB: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

text.KJV: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
text.ASV: because it goeth not into his heart, but into his belly, and goeth out into the draught? `This he said', making all meats clean.
text.WEB: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, thus purifying all foods?”

text.KJV: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
text.ASV: And he said, That which proceedeth out of the man, that defileth the man.
text.WEB: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

text.KJV: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
text.ASV: For from within, out of the heart of men, evil thoughts proceed, fornications, thefts, murders, adulteries,
text.WEB: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

text.KJV: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
text.ASV: covetings, wickednesses, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, railing, pride, foolishness:
text.WEB: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

text.KJV: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
text.ASV: all these evil things proceed from within, and defile the man.
text.WEB: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.”

text.KJV: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
text.ASV: And from thence he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. And he entered into a house, and would have no man know it; and he could not be hid.
text.WEB: From there he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house, and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

text.KJV: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
text.ASV: But straightway a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
text.WEB: For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

text.KJV: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
text.ASV: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. And she besought him that he would cast forth the demon out of her daughter.
text.WEB: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

text.KJV: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
text.ASV: And he said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread and cast it to the dogs.
text.WEB: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

text.KJV: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
text.ASV: But she answered and saith unto him, Yea, Lord; even the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
text.WEB: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

text.KJV: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
text.ASV: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the demon is gone out of thy daughter.
text.WEB: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

text.KJV: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
text.ASV: And she went away unto her house, and found the child laid upon the bed, and the demon gone out.
text.WEB: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

text.KJV: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
text.ASV: And again he went out from the borders of Tyre, and came through Sidon unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the borders of Decapolis.
text.WEB: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

text.KJV: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
text.ASV: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to lay his hand upon him.
text.WEB: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

text.KJV: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
text.ASV: And he took him aside from the multitude privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue;
text.WEB: He took him aside from the multitude, privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue.

text.KJV: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
text.ASV: and looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
text.WEB: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

text.KJV: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
text.ASV: And his ears were opened, and the bond of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
text.WEB: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

text.KJV: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
text.ASV: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it.
text.WEB: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

text.KJV: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
text.ASV: And they were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well; he maketh even the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
text.WEB: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute speak!”

text.KJV: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
text.ASV: In those days, when there was again a great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them,
text.WEB: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself, and said to them,

text.KJV: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
text.ASV: I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat:
text.WEB: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.

text.KJV: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
text.ASV: and if I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way; and some of them are come from far.
text.WEB: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

text.KJV: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
text.ASV: And his disciples answered him, Whence shall one be able to fill these men with bread here in a desert place?
text.WEB: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

text.KJV: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
text.ASV: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
text.WEB: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

text.KJV: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
text.ASV: And he commandeth the multitude to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and having given thanks, he brake, and gave to his disciples, to set before them; and they set them before the multitude.
text.WEB: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them, and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

text.KJV: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
text.ASV: And they had a few small fishes: and having blessed them, he commanded to set these also before them.
text.WEB: They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

text.KJV: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
text.ASV: And they ate, and were filled: and they took up, of broken pieces that remained over, seven baskets.
text.WEB: They ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

text.KJV: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
text.ASV: And they were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
text.WEB: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

text.KJV: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
text.ASV: And straightway he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
text.WEB: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

text.KJV: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
text.ASV: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, trying him.
text.WEB: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, and testing him.

text.KJV: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
text.ASV: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
text.WEB: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

text.KJV: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
text.ASV: And he left them, and again entering into `the boat' departed to the other side.
text.WEB: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

text.KJV: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
text.ASV: And they forgot to take bread; and they had not in the boat with them more than one loaf.
text.WEB: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

text.KJV: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
text.ASV: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.
text.WEB: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

text.KJV: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
text.ASV: And they reasoned one with another, saying, We have no bread.
text.WEB: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

text.KJV: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
text.ASV: And Jesus perceiving it saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? do ye not yet perceive, neither understand? have ye your heart hardened?
text.WEB: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet, neither understand? Is your heart still hardened?

text.KJV: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
text.ASV: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
text.WEB: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

text.KJV: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
text.ASV: When I brake the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
text.WEB: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

text.KJV: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
text.ASV: And when the seven among the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces took ye up? And they say unto him, Seven.
text.WEB: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Do ye not yet understand?
text.WEB: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

text.KJV: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
text.ASV: And they come unto Bethsaida. And they bring to him a blind man, and beseech him to touch him.
text.WEB: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.

text.KJV: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
text.ASV: And he took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village; and when he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands upon him, he asked him, Seest thou aught?
text.WEB: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

text.KJV: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
text.ASV: And he looked up, and said, I see men; for I behold `them' as trees, walking.
text.WEB: He looked up, and said, “I see men; for I see them like trees walking.”

text.KJV: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
text.ASV: Then again he laid his hands upon his eyes; and he looked stedfastly, and was restored, and saw all things clearly.
text.WEB: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

text.KJV: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
text.ASV: And he sent him away to his home, saying, Do not even enter into the village.
text.WEB: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

text.KJV: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
text.ASV: And Jesus went forth, and his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi: and on the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Who do men say that I am?
text.WEB: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

text.KJV: And they answered, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
text.ASV: And they told him, saying, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, One of the prophets.
text.WEB: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets.”

text.KJV: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
text.ASV: And he asked them, But who say ye that I am? Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
text.WEB: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

text.KJV: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
text.ASV: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
text.WEB: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

text.KJV: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
text.ASV: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, and the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
text.WEB: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

text.KJV: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
text.ASV: And he spake the saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
text.WEB: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

text.KJV: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
text.ASV: But he turning about, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and saith, Get thee behind me, Satan; for thou mindest not the things of God, but the things of men.
text.WEB: But he, turning around, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

text.KJV: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
text.ASV: And he called unto him the multitude with his disciples, and said unto them, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
text.WEB: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples, and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

text.KJV: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
text.ASV: For whosoever would save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's shall save it.
text.WEB: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

text.KJV: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
text.ASV: For what doth it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
text.WEB: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?

text.KJV: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
text.ASV: For what should a man give in exchange for his life?
text.WEB: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

text.KJV: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
text.ASV: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of man also shall be ashamed of him, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
text.WEB: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him, when he comes in his Father’s glory, with the holy angels.”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There are some here of them that stand `by', who shall in no wise taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God come with power.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

text.KJV: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
text.ASV: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and bringeth them up into a high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them;
text.WEB: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

text.KJV: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
text.ASV: and his garments became glistering, exceeding white, so as no fuller on earth can whiten them.
text.WEB: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

text.KJV: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
text.ASV: And there appeared unto them Elijah with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
text.WEB: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

text.KJV: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
text.ASV: And Peter answereth and saith to Jesus, Rabbi, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
text.WEB: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

text.KJV: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
text.ASV: For he knew not what to answer; for they became sore afraid.
text.WEB: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

text.KJV: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
text.ASV: And there came a cloud overshadowing them: and there came a voice out of the cloud, This is my beloved Son: hear ye him.
text.WEB: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

text.KJV: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
text.ASV: And suddenly looking round about, they saw no one any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
text.WEB: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

text.KJV: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
text.ASV: And as they were coming down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, save when the Son of man should have risen again from the dead.
text.WEB: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

text.KJV: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
text.ASV: And they kept the saying, questioning among themselves what the rising again from the dead should mean.
text.WEB: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

text.KJV: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
text.ASV: And they asked him, saying, `How is it' that the scribes say that Elijah must first come?
text.WEB: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

text.KJV: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Elijah indeed cometh first, and restoreth all things: and how is it written of the Son of man, that he should suffer many things and be set at nought?
text.WEB: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

text.KJV: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
text.ASV: But I say unto you, that Elijah is come, and they have also done unto him whatsoever they would, even as it is written of him.
text.WEB: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

text.KJV: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
text.ASV: And when they came to the disciples, they saw a great multitude about them, and scribes questioning with them.
text.WEB: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

text.KJV: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
text.ASV: And straightway all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
text.WEB: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

text.KJV: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
text.ASV: And he asked them, What question ye with them?
text.WEB: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

text.KJV: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
text.ASV: And one of the multitude answered him, Teacher, I brought unto thee my son, who hath a dumb spirit;
text.WEB: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

text.KJV: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
text.ASV: and wheresoever it taketh him, it dasheth him down: and he foameth, and grindeth his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast it out; and they were not able.
text.WEB: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth, and wastes away. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

text.KJV: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
text.ASV: And he answereth them and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him unto me.
text.WEB: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

text.KJV: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
text.ASV: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him grievously; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
text.WEB: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him, and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

text.KJV: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
text.ASV: And he asked his father, How long time is it since this hath come unto him? And he said, From a child.
text.WEB: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has come to him?” He said, “From childhood.

text.KJV: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
text.ASV: And oft-times it hath cast him both into the fire and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.
text.WEB: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water, to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.”

text.KJV: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, If thou canst! All things are possible to him that believeth.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

text.KJV: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
text.ASV: Straightway the father of the child cried out, and said, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
text.WEB: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

text.KJV: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
text.ASV: And when Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I command thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
text.WEB: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

text.KJV: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
text.ASV: And having cried out, and torn him much, he came out: and `the boy' became as one dead; insomuch that the more part said, He is dead.
text.WEB: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead; so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

text.KJV: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
text.ASV: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.
text.WEB: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.

text.KJV: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
text.ASV: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, `How is it' that we could not cast it out?
text.WEB: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

text.KJV: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, This kind can come out by nothing, save by prayer.
text.WEB: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing, except by prayer and fasting.”

text.KJV: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
text.ASV: And they went forth from thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
text.WEB: They went out from there, and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it.

text.KJV: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
text.ASV: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered up into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and when he is killed, after three days he shall rise again.
text.WEB: For he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

text.KJV: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
text.ASV: But they understood not the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
text.WEB: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

text.KJV: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
text.ASV: And they came to Capernaum: and when he was in the house he asked them, What were ye reasoning on the way?
text.WEB: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

text.KJV: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
text.ASV: But they held their peace: for they had disputed one with another on the way, who `was' the greatest.
text.WEB: But they were silent, for they had disputed one with another on the way about who was the greatest.

text.KJV: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
text.ASV: And he sat down, and called the twelve; and he saith unto them, If any man would be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.
text.WEB: He sat down, and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

text.KJV: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
text.ASV: And he took a little child, and set him in the midst of them: and taking him in his arms, he said unto them,
text.WEB: He took a little child, and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

text.KJV: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
text.ASV: Whosoever shall receive one of such little children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever receiveth me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
text.WEB: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

text.KJV: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
text.ASV: John said unto him, Teacher, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbade him, because he followed not us.
text.WEB: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

text.KJV: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
text.ASV: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man who shall do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
text.WEB: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

text.KJV: For he that is not against us is on our part.
text.ASV: For he that is not against us is for us.
text.WEB: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

text.KJV: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
text.ASV: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink, because ye are Christ's, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
text.WEB: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

text.KJV: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
text.ASV: And whosoever shall cause one of these little ones that believe on me to stumble, it were better for him if a great millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
text.WEB: Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

text.KJV: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
text.ASV: And if thy hand cause thee to stumble, cut it off: it is good for thee to enter into life maimed, rather than having thy two hands to go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
text.WEB: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

text.KJV: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
text.ASV: `where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.'
text.WEB: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

text.KJV: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
text.ASV: And if thy foot cause thee to stumble, cut it off: it is good for thee to enter into life halt, rather than having thy two feet to be cast into hell.
text.WEB: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

text.KJV: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
text.ASV: `where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.'
text.WEB: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

text.KJV: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
text.ASV: And if thine eye cause thee to stumble, cast it out: it is good for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell;
text.WEB: If your eye causes you to stumble, cast it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

text.KJV: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
text.ASV: where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
text.WEB: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

text.KJV: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
text.ASV: For every one shall be salted with fire.
text.WEB: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

text.KJV: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
text.ASV: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost its saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace one with another.
text.WEB: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

text.KJV: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
text.ASV: And he arose from thence and cometh into the borders of Judaea and beyond the Jordan: and multitudes come together unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
text.WEB: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

text.ASV: And there came unto him Pharisees, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away `his' wife? trying him.
text.WEB: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

text.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
text.ASV: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
text.WEB: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

text.KJV: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
text.ASV: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
text.WEB: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

text.ASV: But Jesus said unto them, For your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment.
text.WEB: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

text.ASV: But from the beginning of the creation, Male and female made he them.
text.WEB: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

text.KJV: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
text.ASV: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife;
text.WEB: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

text.ASV: and the two shall become one flesh: so that they are no more two, but one flesh.
text.WEB: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

text.KJV: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
text.ASV: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
text.WEB: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

text.KJV: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
text.ASV: And in the house the disciples asked him again of this matter.
text.WEB: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her:
text.WEB: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery against her.

text.KJV: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
text.ASV: and if she herself shall put away her husband, and marry another, she committeth adultery.
text.WEB: If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery.”

text.ASV: And they were bringing unto him little children, that he should touch them: and the disciples rebuked them.
text.WEB: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

text.ASV: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me; forbid them not: for to such belongeth the kingdom of God.

text.KJV: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
text.ASV: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruits of the vineyard.
text.WEB: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

text.KJV: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
text.ASV: And they took him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
text.WEB: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

text.KJV: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
text.ASV: And again he sent unto them another servant; and him they wounded in the head, and handled shamefully.
text.WEB: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

text.KJV: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
text.ASV: And he sent another; and him they killed: and many others; beating some, and killing some.
text.WEB: Again he sent another; and they killed him; and many others, beating some, and killing some.

text.KJV: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
text.ASV: He had yet one, a beloved son: he sent him last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
text.WEB: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

text.KJV: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be our's.
text.ASV: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
text.WEB: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

text.KJV: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
text.ASV: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard.
text.WEB: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

text.KJV: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
text.ASV: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
text.WEB: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

text.KJV: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
text.ASV: Have ye not read even this scripture: The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner;
text.WEB: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner.

text.KJV: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
text.ASV: This was from the Lord, And it is marvellous in our eyes?
text.WEB: This was from the Lord, it is marvelous in our eyes’?”

text.KJV: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
text.ASV: And they sought to lay hold on him; and they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spake the parable against them: and they left him, and went away.
text.WEB: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him, and went away.

text.KJV: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
text.ASV: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, that they might catch him in talk.
text.WEB: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

text.KJV: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
text.ASV: And when they were come, they say unto him, Teacher, we know that thou art true, and carest not for any one; for thou regardest not the person of men, but of a truth teachest the way of God: Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
text.WEB: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

text.KJV: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
text.ASV: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why make ye trial of me? bring me a denarius, that I may see it.
text.WEB: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

text.KJV: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
text.ASV: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
text.WEB: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

text.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto them, Render unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and unto God the things that are God's. And they marvelled greatly at him.
text.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

text.KJV: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
text.ASV: And there come unto him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
text.WEB: There came to him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection. They asked him, saying,

text.KJV: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
text.ASV: Teacher, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave a wife behind him, and leave no child, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
text.WEB: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.’

text.KJV: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
text.ASV: There were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed;
text.WEB: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

text.KJV: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
text.ASV: and the second took her, and died, leaving no seed behind him; and the third likewise:
text.WEB: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

text.KJV: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
text.ASV: and the seven left no seed. Last of all the woman also died.
text.WEB: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

text.KJV: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
text.ASV: In the resurrection whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
text.WEB: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

text.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
text.ASV: Jesus said unto them, Is it not for this cause that ye err, that ye know not the scriptures, nor the power of God?
text.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?

text.KJV: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
text.ASV: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as angels in heaven.
text.WEB: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

text.KJV: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
text.ASV: But as touching the dead, that they are raised; have ye not read in the book of Moses, in `the place concerning' the Bush, how God spake unto him, saying, I `am' the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
text.WEB: But about the dead, that they are raised; haven’t you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

text.KJV: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
text.ASV: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living: ye do greatly err.
text.WEB: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

text.KJV: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
text.ASV: And one of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, What commandment is the first of all?
text.WEB: One of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together. Knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

text.KJV: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
text.ASV: Jesus answered, The first is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God, the Lord is one:
text.WEB: Jesus answered, “The greatest is, ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:

text.KJV: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
text.ASV: and thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength.
text.WEB: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

text.KJV: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
text.ASV: The second is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
text.WEB: The second is like this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

text.KJV: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
text.ASV: And the scribe said unto him, Of a truth, Teacher, thou hast well said that he is one; and there is none other but he:
text.WEB: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,

text.KJV: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
text.ASV: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is much more than all whole burnt-offerings and sacrifices.
text.WEB: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

text.KJV: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
text.ASV: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
text.WEB: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

text.KJV: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and said, as he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that the Christ is the son of David?
text.WEB: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

text.KJV: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
text.ASV: David himself said in the Holy Spirit, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.
text.WEB: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

text.KJV: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
text.ASV: David himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
text.WEB: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

text.KJV: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
text.ASV: And in his teaching he said, Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and `to have' salutations in the marketplaces,
text.WEB: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

text.KJV: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
text.ASV: and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts:
text.WEB: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:

text.KJV: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
text.ASV: they that devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers; these shall receive greater condemnation.
text.WEB: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

text.KJV: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
text.ASV: And he sat down over against the treasury, and beheld how the multitude cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
text.WEB: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

text.KJV: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
text.ASV: And there came a poor widow, and she cast in two mites, which make a farthing.
text.WEB: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

text.KJV: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
text.ASV: And he called unto him his disciples, and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, This poor widow cast in more than all they that are casting into the treasury:
text.WEB: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

text.KJV: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
text.ASV: for they all did cast in of their superfluity; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, `even' all her living.
text.WEB: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

text.KJV: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
