text.ASV: And as he went forth out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Teacher, behold, what manner of stones and what manner of buildings!
text.WEB: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

text.KJV: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
text.ASV: And Jesus said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left here one stone upon another, which shall not be thrown down.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

text.KJV: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
text.ASV: And as he sat on the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
text.WEB: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

text.KJV: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
text.ASV: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what `shall be' the sign when these things are all about to be accomplished?
text.WEB: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

text.KJV: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
text.ASV: And Jesus began to say unto them, Take heed that no man lead you astray.
text.WEB: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

text.KJV: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
text.ASV: Many shall come in my name, saying, I am `he'; and shall lead many astray.
text.WEB: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

text.KJV: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
text.ASV: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars, be not troubled: `these things' must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.
text.WEB: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

text.KJV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
text.ASV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there shall be earthquakes in divers places; there shall be famines: these things are the beginning of travail.
text.WEB: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

text.KJV: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
text.ASV: But take ye heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in synagogues shall ye be beaten; and before governors and kings shall ye stand for my sake, for a testimony unto them.
text.WEB: But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

text.KJV: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
text.ASV: And the gospel must first be preached unto all the nations.
text.WEB: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

text.KJV: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
text.ASV: And when they lead you `to judgment', and deliver you up, be not anxious beforehand what ye shall speak: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye; for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Spirit.
text.WEB: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand, or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

text.KJV: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
text.ASV: And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child; and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
text.WEB: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.

text.KJV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
text.ASV: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.
text.WEB: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

text.KJV: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
text.ASV: But when ye see the abomination of desolation standing where he ought not (let him that readeth understand), then let them that are in Judaea flee unto the mountains:
text.WEB: But when you see the abomination of desolation,; ; spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

text.KJV: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
text.ASV: and let him that is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out his house:
text.WEB: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

text.KJV: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
text.ASV: and let him that is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
text.WEB: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

text.KJV: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
text.ASV: But woe unto them that are with child and to them that give suck in those days!
text.WEB: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

text.KJV: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
text.ASV: And pray ye that it be not in the winter.
text.WEB: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

text.KJV: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
text.ASV: For those days shall be tribulation, such as there hath not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never shall be.
text.WEB: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

text.KJV: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
text.ASV: And except the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the elect's sake, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
text.WEB: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

text.KJV: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
text.ASV: And then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is the Christ; or, Lo, there; believe `it' not:
text.WEB: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

text.KJV: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
text.ASV: for there shall arise false Christs and false prophets, and shall show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, the elect.
text.WEB: For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

text.KJV: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
text.ASV: But take ye heed: behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
text.WEB: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

text.KJV: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
text.ASV: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
text.WEB: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

text.KJV: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
text.ASV: and the stars shall be falling from heaven, and the powers that are in the heavens shall be shaken.
text.WEB: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.;

text.KJV: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
text.ASV: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
text.WEB: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

text.KJV: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
text.ASV: And then shall he send forth the angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
text.WEB: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

text.KJV: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
text.ASV: Now from the fig tree learn her parable: when her branch is now become tender, and putteth forth its leaves, ye know that the summer is nigh;
text.WEB: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

text.KJV: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
text.ASV: even so ye also, when ye see these things coming to pass, know ye that he is nigh, `even' at the doors.
text.WEB: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, until all these things be accomplished.
text.WEB: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

text.KJV: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
text.ASV: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
text.WEB: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

text.KJV: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
text.ASV: But of that day or that hour knoweth no one, not even the angels in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
text.WEB: But of that day or that hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

text.KJV: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
text.ASV: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
text.WEB: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

text.KJV: For the Son of Man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
text.ASV: `It is' as `when' a man, sojourning in another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, to each one his work, commanded also the porter to watch.
text.WEB: “It is like a man, traveling to another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

text.KJV: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
text.ASV: Watch therefore: for ye know not when the lord of the house cometh, whether at even, or at midnight, or at cockcrowing, or in the morning;
text.WEB: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

text.KJV: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
text.ASV: lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
text.WEB: lest coming suddenly he might find you sleeping.

text.KJV: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
text.ASV: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
text.WEB: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch.”

text.KJV: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
text.ASV: Now after two days was `the feast of' the passover and the unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him with subtlety, and kill him:
text.WEB: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.

text.KJV: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
text.ASV: for they said, Not during the feast, lest haply there shall be a tumult of the people.
text.WEB: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

text.KJV: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
text.ASV: And while he was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster cruse of ointment of pure nard very costly; `and' she brake the cruse, and poured it over his head.
text.WEB: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.

text.KJV: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
text.ASV: But there were some that had indignation among themselves, `saying', To what purpose hath this waste of the ointment been made?
text.WEB: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

text.KJV: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
text.ASV: For this ointment might have been sold for above three hundred shillings, and given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
text.WEB: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor.” They grumbled against her.

text.KJV: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
text.ASV: But Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
text.WEB: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

text.KJV: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
text.ASV: For ye have the poor always with you, and whensoever ye will ye can do them good: but me ye have not always.
text.WEB: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

text.KJV: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
text.ASV: She hath done what she could; she hath anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
text.WEB: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
text.ASV: And verily I say unto you, Wheresoever the gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, that also which this woman hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

text.KJV: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
text.ASV: And Judas Iscariot, he that was one of the twelve, went away unto the chief priests, that he might deliver him unto them.
text.WEB: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

text.KJV: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
text.ASV: And they, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently deliver him `unto them'.
text.WEB: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

text.KJV: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
text.ASV: And on the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the passover, his disciples say unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and make ready that thou mayest eat the passover?
text.WEB: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

text.KJV: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
text.ASV: And he sendeth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him;
text.WEB: He sent two of his disciples, and said to them, “Go into the city, and there you will meet a man carrying a pitcher of water. Follow him,

text.KJV: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
text.ASV: and wheresoever he shall enter in, say to the master of the house, The Teacher saith, Where is my guest-chamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
text.WEB: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

text.KJV: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
text.ASV: And he will himself show you a large upper room furnished `and' ready: and there make ready for us.
text.WEB: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

text.KJV: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
text.ASV: And the disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
text.WEB: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

text.KJV: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
text.ASV: And when it was evening he cometh with the twelve.
text.WEB: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

text.KJV: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
text.ASV: And as they sat and were eating, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you shall betray me, `even' he that eateth with me.
text.WEB: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

text.KJV: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
text.ASV: They began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I?
text.WEB: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

text.KJV: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, `It is' one of the twelve, he that dippeth with me in the dish.
text.WEB: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

text.KJV: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
text.ASV: For the Son of man goeth, even as it is written of him: but woe unto that man through whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had not been born.
text.WEB: For the Son of Man goes, even as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

text.KJV: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
text.ASV: And as they were eating, he took bread, and when he had blessed, he brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take ye: this is my body.
text.WEB: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

text.KJV: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
text.ASV: And he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them: and they all drank of it.
text.WEB: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
text.WEB: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

text.KJV: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
text.ASV: Verily I say unto you, I shall no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
text.WEB: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

text.KJV: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
text.ASV: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out unto the mount of Olives.
text.WEB: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

text.KJV: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
text.ASV: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered abroad.
text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

text.KJV: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
text.ASV: Howbeit, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.
text.WEB: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

text.KJV: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
text.ASV: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
text.WEB: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

text.KJV: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
text.ASV: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, that thou to-day, `even' this night, before the cock crow twice, shalt deny me thrice.
text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

text.KJV: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
text.ASV: But he spake exceedingly vehemently, If I must die with thee, I will not deny thee. And in like manner also said they all.
text.WEB: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

text.KJV: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
text.ASV: And they come unto a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith unto his disciples, Sit ye here, while I pray.
text.WEB: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I pray.”

text.KJV: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
text.ASV: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be greatly amazed, and sore troubled.
text.WEB: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

text.KJV: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful even unto death: abide ye here, and watch.
text.WEB: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.”

text.KJV: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
text.ASV: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
text.WEB: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

text.KJV: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
text.ASV: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; remove this cup from me: howbeit not what I will, but what thou wilt.
text.WEB: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

text.KJV: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
text.ASV: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest thou not watch one hour?
text.WEB: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

text.KJV: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
text.ASV: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
text.WEB: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

text.KJV: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
text.ASV: And again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.
text.WEB: Again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.

text.KJV: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
text.ASV: And again he came, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they knew not what to answer him.
text.WEB: Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn’t know what to answer him.

text.KJV: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text.ASV: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough; the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text.WEB: He came the third time, and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

text.KJV: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
text.ASV: Arise, let us be going: behold, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
text.WEB: Arise, let us be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

text.KJV: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
text.ASV: And straightway, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
text.WEB: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

text.KJV: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
text.ASV: Now he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
text.WEB: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

text.KJV: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
text.ASV: And when he was come, straightway he came to him, and saith, Rabbi; and kissed him.
text.WEB: When he had come, immediately he came to him, and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

text.KJV: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
text.ASV: And they laid hands on him, and took him.
text.WEB: They laid their hands on him, and seized him.

text.KJV: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
text.ASV: But a certain one of them that stood by drew his sword, and smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
text.WEB: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

text.KJV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
text.ASV: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a robber, with swords and staves to seize me?
text.WEB: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

text.KJV: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
text.ASV: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but `this is done' that the scriptures might be fulfilled.
text.WEB: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

text.KJV: And they all forsook him, and fled.
text.ASV: And they all left him, and fled.
text.WEB: They all left him, and fled.

text.KJV: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
text.ASV: And a certain young man followed with him, having a linen cloth cast about him, over `his' naked `body': and they lay hold on him;
text.WEB: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

text.KJV: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
text.ASV: but he left the linen cloth, and fled naked.
text.WEB: but he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

text.KJV: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
text.ASV: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and there come together with him all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
text.WEB: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

text.KJV: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
text.ASV: And Peter had followed him afar off, even within, into the court of the high priest; and he was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light `of the fire'.
text.WEB: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

text.KJV: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
text.ASV: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found it not.
text.WEB: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

text.KJV: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
text.ASV: For many bare false witness against him, and their witness agreed not together.
text.WEB: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

text.KJV: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
text.ASV: And there stood up certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
text.WEB: Some stood up, and gave false testimony against him, saying,

text.KJV: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
text.ASV: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.
text.WEB: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

text.KJV: But neither so did their witness agree together.
text.ASV: And not even so did their witness agree together.
text.WEB: Even so, their testimony did not agree.

text.KJV: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
text.ASV: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
text.WEB: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

text.KJV: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
text.ASV: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and saith unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
text.WEB: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

text.KJV: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
text.ASV: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.
text.WEB: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

text.KJV: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
text.ASV: And the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What further need have we of witnesses?
text.WEB: The high priest tore his clothes, and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

text.KJV: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
text.ASV: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be worthy of death.
text.WEB: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

text.KJV: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
text.ASV: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the officers received him with blows of their hands.
text.WEB: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

text.KJV: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
text.ASV: And as Peter was beneath in the court, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest;
text.WEB: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

text.KJV: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
text.ASV: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and saith, Thou also wast with the Nazarene, `even' Jesus.
text.WEB: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

text.KJV: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
text.ASV: But he denied, saying, I neither know, nor understand what thou sayest: and he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
text.WEB: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know, nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

text.KJV: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
text.ASV: And the maid saw him, and began again to say to them that stood by, This is `one' of them.
text.WEB: The maid saw him, and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

text.KJV: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
text.ASV: But he again denied it. And after a little while again they that stood by said to Peter, of a truth thou art `one' of them; for thou art a Galilaean.
text.WEB: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

text.KJV: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
text.ASV: But he began to curse, and to swear, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
text.WEB: But he began to curse, and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

text.KJV: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
text.ASV: And straightway the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word, how that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
text.WEB: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

text.KJV: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
text.ASV: And straightway in the morning the chief priests with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
text.WEB: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

text.KJV: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto them, Thou sayest it.
text.ASV: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering saith unto him, Thou sayest.
text.WEB: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

text.KJV: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
text.ASV: And the chief priests accused him of many things.
text.WEB: The chief priests accused him of many things.

text.KJV: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
text.ASV: And Pilate again asked him, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they accuse thee of.
text.WEB: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

text.KJV: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
text.ASV: But Jesus no more answered anything; insomuch that Pilate marvelled.
text.WEB: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

text.KJV: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
text.ASV: Now at the feast he used to release unto them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.
text.WEB: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.

text.KJV: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
text.ASV: And there was one called Barabbas, `lying' bound with them that had made insurrection, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
text.WEB: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

text.KJV: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
text.ASV: And the multitude went up and began to ask him `to do' as he was wont to do unto them.
text.WEB: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

text.KJV: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
text.ASV: And Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
text.WEB: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

text.KJV: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
text.ASV: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
text.WEB: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

text.KJV: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
text.ASV: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
text.WEB: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

text.KJV: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
text.ASV: And Pilate again answered and said unto them, What then shall I do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
text.WEB: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

text.KJV: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
text.ASV: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
text.WEB: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

text.KJV: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
text.ASV: And Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out exceedingly, Crucify him.
text.WEB: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

text.KJV: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
text.ASV: And Pilate, wishing to content the multitude, released unto them Barabbas, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
text.WEB: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

text.KJV: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
text.ASV: And the soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
text.WEB: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

text.KJV: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
text.ASV: And they clothe him with purple, and platting a crown of thorns, they put it on him;
text.WEB: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

text.KJV: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
text.ASV: and they began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
text.WEB: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

text.KJV: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
text.ASV: And they smote his head with a reed, and spat upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
text.WEB: They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

text.KJV: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
text.ASV: And when they had mocked him, they took off from him the purple, and put on him his garments. And they lead him out to crucify him.
text.WEB: When they had mocked him, they took the purple off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

text.KJV: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
text.ASV: And they compel one passing by, Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go `with them', that he might bear his cross.
text.WEB: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.

text.KJV: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
text.ASV: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
text.WEB: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

text.KJV: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
text.ASV: And they offered him wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
text.WEB: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

text.KJV: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
text.ASV: And they crucify him, and part his garments among them, casting lots upon them, what each should take.
text.WEB: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

text.KJV: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
text.ASV: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
text.WEB: It was the third hour, and they crucified him.

text.KJV: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
text.ASV: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
text.WEB: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

text.KJV: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
text.ASV: And with him they crucify two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.
text.WEB: With him they crucified two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.

text.KJV: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
text.ASV: `And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was reckoned with transgressors.'
text.WEB: The Scripture was fulfilled, which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

text.KJV: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
text.ASV: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ha! Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
text.WEB: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads, and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days,

text.KJV: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
text.ASV: save thyself, and come down from the cross.
text.WEB: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

text.KJV: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
text.ASV: In like manner also the chief priests mocking `him' among themselves with the scribes said, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
text.WEB: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

text.KJV: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
text.ASV: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reproached him.
text.WEB: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

text.KJV: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
text.ASV: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
text.WEB: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

text.KJV: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
text.ASV: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
text.WEB: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

text.KJV: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
text.ASV: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elijah.
text.WEB: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

text.KJV: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
text.ASV: And one ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to take him down.
text.WEB: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

text.KJV: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
text.ASV: And Jesus uttered a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
text.WEB: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

text.KJV: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
text.ASV: And the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom.
text.WEB: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

text.KJV: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
text.ASV: And when the centurion, who stood by over against him, saw that he so gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
text.WEB: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

text.KJV: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
text.ASV: And there were also women beholding from afar: among whom `were' both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
text.WEB: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

text.KJV: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
text.ASV: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him; and many other women that came up with him unto Jerusalem.
text.WEB: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

text.KJV: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
text.ASV: And when even was now come, because it was the Preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
text.WEB: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

text.KJV: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
text.ASV: there came Joseph of Arimathaea, a councillor of honorable estate, who also himself was looking for the kingdom of God; and he boldly went in unto Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.
text.WEB: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

text.KJV: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
text.ASV: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
text.WEB: Pilate marveled if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

text.KJV: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
text.ASV: And when he learned it of the centurion, he granted the corpse to Joseph.
text.WEB: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

text.KJV: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
text.ASV: And he bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been hewn out of a rock; and he rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
text.WEB: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

text.KJV: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
text.ASV: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the `mother' of Joses beheld where he was laid.
text.WEB: Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

text.KJV: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
text.ASV: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the `mother' of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
text.WEB: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

text.KJV: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
text.ASV: And very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb when the sun was risen.
text.WEB: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

text.KJV: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
text.ASV: And they were saying among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb?
text.WEB: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

text.KJV: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
text.ASV: and looking up, they see that the stone is rolled back: for it was exceeding great.
text.WEB: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

text.KJV: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
text.ASV: And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, arrayed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
text.WEB: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.

text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Be not amazed: ye seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who hath been crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold, the place where they laid him!
text.WEB: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!

text.KJV: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
text.ASV: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, He goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
text.WEB: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

text.KJV: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
text.ASV: And they went out, and fled from the tomb; for trembling and astonishment had come upon them: and they said nothing to any one; for they were afraid.
text.WEB: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

text.KJV: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
text.ASV: Now when he was risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
text.WEB: as reliable based on an overwhelming majority of textual evidence, including not only the authoritative Greek Majority Text New Testament, but also the TR and many of the manuscripts cited in the NU text.Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

text.KJV: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
text.ASV: She went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
text.WEB: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

text.KJV: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
text.ASV: And they, when they heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, disbelieved.
text.WEB: When they heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

text.KJV: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
text.ASV: And after these things he was manifested in another form unto two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
text.WEB: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.

text.KJV: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
text.ASV: And they went away and told it unto the rest: neither believed they them.
text.WEB: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

text.KJV: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
text.ASV: And afterward he was manifested unto the eleven themselves as they sat at meat; and he upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them that had seen him after he was risen.
text.WEB: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

text.KJV: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
text.ASV: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that disbelieveth shall be condemned.
text.WEB: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

text.KJV: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
text.ASV: And these signs shall accompany them that believe: in my name shall they cast out demons; they shall speak with new tongues;
text.WEB: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

text.KJV: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
text.ASV: they shall take up serpents, and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall in no wise hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
text.WEB: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

text.KJV: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
text.ASV: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken unto them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
text.WEB: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

text.KJV: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
text.ASV: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
text.WEB: They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
